_comment: TEMPLATE FILE — copy to config/user.json and fill in your own values. This example file IS committed to git; user.json is gitignored.

integrations._connector_note: Slack, Gmail, Indeed, ZipRecruiter and Dice authenticate over OAuth in the Claude app (Settings -> Connectors). There is no API key for them in .env. Only the preferences below live here.
integrations._budget_note: Indeed and ZipRecruiter authenticate as YOUR account, so Career OS caps its own usage rather than exhausting a service you rely on personally. Effective cap = assumed_daily_limit * cap_fraction. Neither provider publishes a per-account MCP quota, so assumed_daily_limit is an assumption — raise it if you learn the real number. Set assumed_daily_limit to 0 to mark a connector unmetered. Enforced by scripts/mcp-budget.py.

recruiter_connect._note: recruiter-connect settings. Caps protect your reputation and LinkedIn account; change them deliberately. The snapshot is reused in every recruiter message so notice period and availability never differ between people.
